english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for restoring a person to health or bringing an illness to an end.
This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something cures an illness or heals a wound.

examples.english: This medicine can cure my stomachache quickly.
examples.traditional: 呢隻藥好快就醫好咗我嘅胃痛。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 hou2 faai3 zau6 ji1 hou2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 wai6 tung3

examples.english: The doctor helped heal my leg at last.
examples.traditional: 醫生終於醫好咗我隻腳。
examples.jyutping: ji1 sang1 zung1 jyu1 ji1 hou2 zo2 ngo5 zek3 goek3
